summary: This is a 6-K filing by Cellectis S.A., a foreign private issuer, reporting a press release about its presentation of an epigenetic editing platform at the ASGCT annual meeting. The filing discusses a TALE-based approach that turns genes off without altering DNA, achieving 90% reduction in gene activity in preclinical studies. There are no terms of a corporate transaction, no board recommendation, no advisor, and no structural mechanics related to a special situation. This is a routine business update on research progress, not a special-situation event.
